Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the American League was established in 1900 based on a search result snippet mentioning the Western League was renamed in 1900. This was a misinterpretation of the search results; the snippet actually stated the league changed its name in 1900 but explicitly developed into a major league in 1901. The Planner failed to distinguish between the renaming of the minor league (1900) and the establishment of the American League as a major league (1901), leading to an incorrect decision to search for "1900" as the answer. This error caused a cycle of redundant searches and confusion regarding the correct year.
